extract-text-from-pdf-to-utf8-txt.title: Extract Text from PDF to UTF-8 Text File
extract-text-from-pdf-to-utf8-txt.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor to extract plain text from a PDF document and save it as a UTF-8 encoded .txt file.

extract-pdf-text-in-memory.title: Extract Text from PDF Using MemoryStreams
extract-pdf-text-in-memory.description: Shows how to load a PDF from a MemoryStream, extract its text with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, and write the extracted text into another MemoryStream for further in‑memory processing.

check-pdf-contains-text.title: Check if PDF Contains Text via MemoryStream
check-pdf-contains-text.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract PDF text into a MemoryStream and determine if any text is present by checking the stream length.

batch-extract-text-from-pdfs.title: Batch Extract Text from PDFs
batch-extract-text-from-pdfs.description: Shows how to iterate over a folder of PDF files, extract their text using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, and save each output as a .txt file with the same base name.

check-pdf-for-text-and-images.title: Detect Text and Images in a PDF with PdfExtractor
check-pdf-for-text-and-images.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to determine whether a PDF contains at least one text fragment and one image.

extract-text-and-images-from-pdf.title: Extract Text and Images from PDF using PdfExtractor
extract-text-and-images-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a PdfExtractor, bind a PDF file, enable simultaneous text and image extraction, save the extracted text to a file, and iterate through pages to save each image.

extract-text-from-protected-pdf.title: Extract Text from Password-Protected PDF
extract-text-from-protected-pdf.description: Shows how to open a PDF with an owner password using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and extract all its text to a plain‑text file.

extract-pdf-text-utf8.title: Extract PDF Text and Save as UTF-8 File
extract-pdf-text-utf8.description: Shows how to extract text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and write the result to a UTF‑8 encoded text file.

extract-text-from-pdf-byte-array.title: Extract Text from PDF Stored in Memory Using PdfExtractor
extract-text-from-pdf-byte-array.description: Shows how to bind a PdfExtractor to a PDF held in a byte array and retrieve the extracted text without any file I/O.

extract-pdf-text-per-page.title: Extract Text from PDF and Split into Pages
extract-pdf-text-per-page.description: Demonstrates extracting all text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, reading it via a MemoryStream, and splitting the result into separate page files using the form‑feed delimiter.

pdf-extractor-unit-test.title: Extract Text from PDF Using PdfExtractor
pdf-extractor-unit-test.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF file, extract its text with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, and compare the result to an expected string.

extract-text-from-pdf.title: Extract Text from PDF Using Aspose.Pdf Facade
extract-text-from-pdf.description: Shows how to bind a PDF file to Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, extract all text, and write the result to the console.

extract-pdf-text-to-stringbuilder.title: Extract PDF Text to StringBuilder and Save
extract-pdf-text-to-stringbuilder.description: Demonstrates how to extract text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, store it in a StringBuilder for manipulation, and then write the processed text to a file.

extract-text-to-temp-file-and-verify.title: Extract PDF Text and Verify via Temporary File
extract-text-to-temp-file-and-verify.description: Demonstrates extracting text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, saving the text to a temporary file, reading it back, and confirming the saved content matches the original extraction.

extract-pdf-text-and-encrypt-aes.title: Extract PDF Text and Encrypt with AES
extract-pdf-text-and-encrypt-aes.description: Shows how to extract text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and then encrypt the resulting .txt file with AES before saving.

check-pdf-text-only-by-detecting-images.title: Detect Text‑Only PDF by Extracting Images
check-pdf-text-only-by-detecting-images.description: Demonstrates extracting all images from a PDF using PdfExtractor and determining if the document is text‑only by checking whether any image files were created.

extract-pdf-text-to-postgresql.title: Extract PDF Text and Save to PostgreSQL
extract-pdf-text-to-postgresql.description: Demonstrates extracting all text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and inserting the extracted content into a PostgreSQL table for searchable indexing.

cancel-pdf-image-extraction.title: Cancel PDF Text Extraction with a CancellationToken
cancel-pdf-image-extraction.description: Shows how to extract text from a PDF page‑by‑page using Aspose.Pdf and abort the operation on user request via a CancellationToken.

extract-pdf-text-to-memorystream.title: Extract PDF Text and Re‑create PDF via MemoryStream
extract-pdf-text-to-memorystream.description: Demonstrates extracting text from a PDF, wrapping it in simple HTML, loading that HTML into a new PDF document, and outputting the result to a MemoryStream for further processing.

extract-pdf-text-to-gzip.title: Extract PDF Text and Compress to GZip
extract-pdf-text-to-gzip.description: Shows how to extract text from a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and write the extracted content to a GZip compressed file.

report-pdf-page-image-attachment-counts.title: Report PDF Page, Image, and Attachment Counts
report-pdf-page-image-attachment-counts.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and retrieve the total number of pages, embedded images, and file attachments.

create-pdf-summary-from-first-three-page.title: Create PDF Summary with First Three Pages Text
create-pdf-summary-from-first-three-page.description: Shows how to extract text from the first three pages of a PDF and generate a new PDF that contains this extracted text as a summary document.

retry-pdf-text-extraction.title: Retry PDF Text Extraction with PdfExtractor
retry-pdf-text-extraction.description: Demonstrates extracting text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor with a retry loop that attempts up to three times when an IOException occurs.

extract-pdf-text-to-azure-table.title: Extract PDF Text and Prepare Azure Table Entity
extract-pdf-text-to-azure-table.description: Demonstrates extracting all text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's TextAbsorber and storing it in a simple Azure Table entity with the document ID as the partition key.

async-pdf-text-image-extraction.title: Asynchronously Extract Text and Images from PDF
async-pdf-text-image-extraction.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf to extract all text and images from a PDF file asynchronously, avoiding UI thread blocking.

extract-pdf-text-to-stringwriter.title: Extract PDF Text to StringWriter for Logging
extract-pdf-text-to-stringwriter.description: Demonstrates extracting all text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and writing it to a StringWriter, which can be fed into logging frameworks.

configurable-pdf-extraction.title: Configurable PDF Text, Image, and Attachment Extraction
configurable-pdf-extraction.description: Demonstrates how to extract text, images, and embedded attachments from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf with a JSON configuration file to toggle each operation without code changes.

extract-images-from-pages-png.title: Extract Images from Specific PDF Pages as PNG
extract-images-from-pages-png.description: Demonstrates configuring PdfExtractor to extract images only from pages 5 through 10 of a PDF and save each extracted image as a PNG file.

extract-resource-images-pdf-extractor.title: Extract Resource-Based Images from PDF
extract-resource-images-pdf-extractor.description: Demonstrates how to configure PdfExtractor to extract only images that are defined in the PDF resources and save them as PNG files.

extract-images-first-page-to-byte-arrays.title: Extract Images from First PDF Page to Byte Arrays
extract-images-first-page-to-byte-arrays.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to pull all images from the first page of a PDF and store each image directly in a byte array for further processing.

extract-images-to-bmp.title: Extract PDF Images and Save as BMP
extract-images-to-bmp.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF and save each one directly as a BMP file, preserving the original resolution and color depth.

extract-pdf-images-to-jpeg-quality-85.title: Export PDF Pages to JPEG Images
extract-pdf-images-to-jpeg-quality-85.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate through its pages, and convert each page to a JPEG image with 300 DPI and quality 85, saving the results to a directory.

extract-images-from-pdf-to-temp-folder.title: Extract Images from PDF Using Aspose.Pdf
extract-images-from-pdf-to-temp-folder.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF and save them as PNG files in a temporary directory.

extract-images-to-base64.title: Extract PDF Images to Base64 JSON
extract-images-to-base64.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF, convert each image stream to a Base64 string, and serialize the collection into JSON for transmission.

extract-images-from-specific-pdf-page.title: Extract Images from a Single PDF Page
extract-images-from-specific-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from a specific page by setting StartPage and EndPage to the same value.

extract-images-to-tiff.title: Extract Images from PDF and Save as TIFF
extract-images-to-tiff.description: Demonstrates extracting all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and saving each image as a lossless TIFF file for archival storage.

extract-images-validate-signature.title: Extract Images from PDF and Validate Their Signatures
extract-images-validate-signature.description: Demonstrates how to extract all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, save them as PNG files, and then verify each saved image by checking its file signature (magic number) to detect corruption.

parallel-image-extraction-from-pdfs.title: Parallel Image Extraction from Multiple PDFs
parallel-image-extraction-from-pdfs.description: Demonstrates extracting all images from several PDF files concurrently using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and Task.WhenAll to improve throughput.

extract-images-to-unc-share.title: Extract Images from PDF to UNC Network Share
extract-images-to-unc-share.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF and save them to a UNC network share with proper formatting and file extensions.

extract-images-and-create-thumbnails.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create Thumbnails
extract-images-and-create-thumbnails.description: Demonstrates extracting all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and generating PNG thumbnails with a maximum dimension of 200 pixels.

extract-images-from-pdf-using-pdfextract.title: Extract Images from PDF Using PdfExtractor with Automatic Disposal
extract-images-from-pdf-using-pdfextract.description: Demonstrates how to extract all images from a PDF file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor wrapped in a using block for deterministic disposal.

extract-images-from-encrypted-pdf.title: Extract Images from Encrypted PDF
extract-images-from-encrypted-pdf.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF with a user password and extract all embedded images to PNG files using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-text-only-ignore-images.title: Extract Text from PDF While Ignoring Images
extract-text-only-ignore-images.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract only the textual content of a PDF by omitting the ExtractImage call, effectively ignoring images.

extract-images-to-html-report.title: Extract Images from PDF and Embed in HTML Report
extract-images-to-html-report.description: Shows how to extract all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and embed each image as a base64 data URI in an HTML file.

handle-corrupted-pdf-binding.title: Error Handling for PdfExtractor Binding
handle-corrupted-pdf-binding.description: Demonstrates how to catch PdfException when PdfExtractor fails to bind a corrupted PDF file, extract its text, and write the output safely using proper resource disposal.

extract-pdf-images-to-azure-blob.title: Extract Images from PDF to Azure Blob Container
extract-pdf-images-to-azure-blob.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF file and save them into an Azure Blob container (simulated here with a local folder).

extract-images-and-compress-png-zip.title: Extract Images from PDF and Save as Compressed PNG
extract-images-and-compress-png-zip.description: Demonstrates how to extract all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and save each one as a losslessly compressed PNG file.

extract-images-original-format-pdfextrac.title: Extract Images from PDF in Original Format
extract-images-original-format-pdfextrac.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF while preserving their original format.

extract-images-pdf-csv-manifest.title: Extract Images from PDF and Generate CSV Manifest
extract-images-pdf-csv-manifest.description: Demonstrates how to extract all images from each page of a PDF, save them as PNG files, and create a CSV manifest that records the file name, page number, and original dimensions.

extract-pdf-images-to-s3.title: Extract Images from PDF and Upload to Amazon S3
extract-pdf-images-to-s3.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract images from a PDF document and upload each image to an Amazon S3 bucket using the AWS SDK.

extract-pdf-text-with-progress.title: Extract Text from PDF with Progress Reporting
extract-pdf-text-with-progress.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor to extract text page‑by‑page from a large PDF while updating the console with progress information.

extract-all-images-from-pdf.title: Extract All Images from PDF Using PdfExtractor
extract-all-images-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to extract every image from a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor by setting StartPage to 1 and EndPage to 0.

extract-images-ocr-openai-copilot.title: Extract Images from PDF and Prepare for OCR
extract-images-ocr-openai-copilot.description: Shows how to iterate through a PDF document, extract each embedded image to PNG files, and provides a placeholder for applying OCR to the saved images.

list-embedded-attachment-names.title: List Embedded Attachment Names in PDF
list-embedded-attachment-names.description: Shows how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and enumerate the names of all embedded file attachments without saving them.

extract-embedded-attachments-from-pdf.title: Extract Embedded File Attachments from PDF
extract-embedded-attachments-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, enumerate its embedded file attachments, and write each attachment to a specified output folder.

extract-pdf-attachments-with-timestamp.title: Extract and Rename PDF Attachments with Timestamp
extract-pdf-attachments-with-timestamp.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through embedded files in a PDF, extract each attachment, and save it with a timestamp and counter‑based filename.

extract-attachments-compute-sha256.title: Extract PDF Attachments and Verify with SHA-256 Hashes
extract-attachments-compute-sha256.description: Loads a PDF, extracts all embedded attachments to a directory, then computes a SHA‑256 hash for each saved file to confirm integrity.

extract-pdf-attachments-by-extension.title: Extract PDF Attachments and Organize by Extension
extract-pdf-attachments-by-extension.description: Demonstrates how to extract embedded file attachments from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and then move them into sub‑folders named after each file's original extension.

extract-images-from-pdf-with-guid-filena.title: Extract Images from PDF with GUID Filenames
extract-images-from-pdf-with-guid-filena.description: Demonstrates how to extract all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and save each image with a unique GUID‑based filename to avoid naming collisions.

extract-images-from-pdf-to-zip.title: Extract Images from PDF and Save to ZIP
extract-images-from-pdf-to-zip.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to pull all images from a PDF and store them as individual files inside a ZIP archive.

create-contact-sheet-pdf-from-extracted-.title: Create Contact Sheet PDF from Extracted Images
create-contact-sheet-pdf-from-extracted-.description: Extracts all images from a source PDF and assembles them into a new PDF that displays the images as thumbnails arranged in a grid.

extract-images-create-pdf-portfolio.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create Image Portfolio PDF
extract-images-create-pdf-portfolio.description: The example extracts all images from an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, then creates a new PDF where each image is placed on its own page as an ImageStamp.

add-watermark-extract-images-from-pdf.title: Extract PDF Images and Add Watermark
add-watermark-extract-images-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to extract all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, overlay a text watermark on each image, and save the results as PNG files.

extract-images-pdf-to-base64-json.title: Extract Images from PDF and Output Base64 JSON
extract-images-pdf-to-base64-json.description: The example extracts all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, saves each as a PNG, converts it to a Base64 string, and produces a JSON array containing the Base64 data, file name, and size.

extract-images-pdf-csv-index.title: Extract Images from PDF and Generate CSV Report
extract-images-pdf-csv-index.description: Shows how to extract every image from each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, save the images to a folder, and create a CSV file that records the image filename, page number, width, and height.

extract-images-create-sprite-sheet.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create Sprite Sheet
extract-images-create-sprite-sheet.description: Demonstrates extracting all images from a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, saving them as PNG files, and combining them into a single sprite sheet image.

extract-images-to-pdfa2b.title: Extract Images from PDF and Generate PDF/A‑2b Document
extract-images-to-pdfa2b.description: The example extracts all images from an existing PDF, places each image on a separate page of a new PDF, and then converts the result to a PDF/A‑2b compliant document.

extract-images-from-pdf-to-unc.title: Extract Images from PDF to UNC Network Share
extract-images-from-pdf-to-unc.description: Demonstrates extracting all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and saving them as PNG files to a network‑mapped UNC folder.

extract-images-html-gallery.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create HTML Gallery
extract-images-html-gallery.description: The example extracts all images from each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor, saves them as PNG files, and generates a simple HTML page that displays the extracted images as a gallery.

extract-images-pdf-create-video-slidesho.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create Video Slideshow
extract-images-pdf-create-video-slidesho.description: Demonstrates extracting all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and then generating a video slideshow with FFmpeg.

extract-pdf-images-to-gcs.title: Extract PDF Images and Upload to Google Cloud Storage
extract-pdf-images-to-gcs.description: Demonstrates extracting images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and uploading them to a Google Cloud Storage bucket with public read access.

extract-images-by-keyword.title: Extract Images from Pages Containing a Keyword
extract-images-by-keyword.description: Demonstrates scanning a PDF for a specific keyword, identifying the pages that contain it, and extracting only the images from those pages using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-images-markdown-gallery.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create Markdown Gallery
extract-images-markdown-gallery.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF and generate a Markdown file that displays the images as a gallery.

extract-text-and-images-from-pdfs.title: Extract Text from PDFs Using Aspose PdfExtractor
extract-text-and-images-from-pdfs.description: Demonstrates a .NET console service that reads PDF files from a directory, extracts raw text with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, and writes the output to .txt files.

batch-extract-text-from-pdfs-azure-blob.title: Extract Text from PDFs and Save as Text Files
batch-extract-text-from-pdfs-azure-blob.description: Demonstrates how to iterate over PDF files, use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract UTF‑8 text, and write the results to .txt files, simulating a batch job for Azure Blob storage.

extract-images-pdf-to-word.title: Extract Images from PDF and Save to Files
extract-images-pdf-to-word.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF document and save each image as a separate file.

extract-pdf-images-to-sqlite.title: Extract Images from PDF and Store as SQLite BLOBs
extract-pdf-images-to-sqlite.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to pull images from a PDF, save them as files, and record their metadata in a CSV that simulates a SQLite BLOB table.

extract-pdf-images-to-s3-with-encryption.title: Extract Images from PDF and Upload to S3 with Server‑Side Encryption
extract-pdf-images-to-s3-with-encryption.description: Demonstrates extracting images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and uploading each image to an Amazon S3 bucket with AES‑256 server‑side encryption.

batch-extract-text-from-pdfs__v2.title: Batch PDF Text Extraction via PowerShell Wrapper
batch-extract-text-from-pdfs__v2.description: Demonstrates a minimal C# entry point that prepares the environment for a PowerShell script which uses Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to batch extract text from all PDFs in a directory.

extract-text-from-pdf__v2.title: Extract Text from PDF Using Aspose PdfExtractor
extract-text-from-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates a command‑line utility that loads a PDF file, extracts its textual content with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, and writes the result to standard output.

extract-pdf-text-with-progress__v2.title: Extract Text from PDF with Progress Bar
extract-pdf-text-with-progress__v2.description: Shows how to extract text from a PDF file page‑by‑page using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor while displaying a console progress bar.

watch-folder-extract-pdf-text.title: Watch Folder and Extract Text from New PDFs
watch-folder-extract-pdf-text.description: Demonstrates a Windows‑style service that monitors a directory for newly created PDF files and uses Aspose.Pdf to extract their text into corresponding .txt files.

extract-text-from-pdf-byte-array__v2.title: Extract Text from PDF and Return JSON
extract-text-from-pdf-byte-array__v2.description: Demonstrates how to read a PDF file into a byte array, use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract its text, and output the result as a JSON object.

extract-text-from-pdf-queue-trigger.title: Extract Text from PDFs Using Aspose PdfExtractor
extract-text-from-pdf-queue-trigger.description: Shows how to load PDF files, extract their textual content with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, and write the UTF‑8 text to .txt files.
